question: Which of the following processes is absent in C₄ plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Photorespiration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **C₄ plants**, such as maize and sugarcane, exhibit an adaptation mechanism to minimize **photorespiration**, which is absent in these plants.
 
• **Photorespiration** is a process that occurs in **C₃ plants** due to the oxygenation activity of **Rubisco**, the enzyme responsible for carbon fixation during photosynthesis.
 
• In **C₄ plants**, the spatial separation of carbon fixation (in mesophyll cells) and Calvin cycle (in bundle sheath cells) prevents the oxygenation activity of Rubisco. *Hence, photorespiration is absent in C₄ plants.*
 
• **Transpiration** (the loss of water through stomata), **photosynthesis** (the process of converting light energy into chemical energy), and **respiration** (the breakdown of glucose to release energy) occur in **C₄ plants**. *Hence, these processes are present in C₄ plants.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Photorespiration.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Photorespiration:**

 
 
• Occurs in **C₃ plants** due to the oxygenation activity of Rubisco when the concentration of **oxygen** is higher than **carbon dioxide**.
 
• Photorespiration leads to the formation of **phosphoglycolate**, which needs to be recycled, resulting in a loss of energy and reduced photosynthetic efficiency.
 
 
 
• **C₄ Plants:**
 
 
• Plants like **maize**, **sugarcane**, and **sorghum** exhibit the **C₄ pathway** for photosynthesis.
 
• These plants use a specialized mechanism involving the enzyme **PEP carboxylase** to fix carbon dioxide into **oxaloacetate** in mesophyll cells.
 
• **Bundle sheath cells** carry out the Calvin cycle, ensuring that Rubisco is exposed to a high concentration of carbon dioxide, preventing photorespiration.
 
 
 
• **Comparison between C₃ and C₄ Plants:**
 
 
• **C₃ plants:** Include wheat, rice, and barley. They rely solely on Rubisco and are more prone to photorespiration under high temperatures and low CO₂ levels.
 
• **C₄ plants:** Exhibit adaptations like Kranz anatomy and the utilization of PEP carboxylase to minimize photorespiration.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kranz Anatomy:**

 
 
• C₄ plants show a specialized leaf anatomy called **Kranz anatomy**, where mesophyll cells surround bundle sheath cells in a wreath-like arrangement.
 
• This spatial separation is crucial for preventing photorespiration and enhancing photosynthetic efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of C₄ Pathway:**
 
 
• Allows plants to thrive in **hot**, **dry**, and **high-light environments**.
 
• Improves the efficiency of carbon fixation, making C₄ plants more productive.
